@copilot Update this PR directly to finish the original messaging Gradle rollout's RabbitMQ lifecycle requirement. Keep the existing cloud-managed head branch, do not rename or switch branches, and do not create another PR.

The layout migration is delivered, and its initial Copilot review 5792455030 has no findings. One originally requested acceptance criterion remains: reliably realize and include every ordinary RabbitMQ verification suite and its variants in check. The current RabbitMQ script still has no check dependency on testing.suites. Both named executions selectors use lazy named(...).configure in TestSuiteExecutions.kt, and the shared testing conventions configure suites lazily rather than establishing independent custom-suite check membership. Registering these selectors is not itself a lifecycle guarantee.

In instrumentation/rabbitmq-2.7/javaagent/build.gradle.kts, add ordinary suite-collection check wiring using the existing pattern tasks.check { dependsOn(testing.suites) }. Keep all existing execution selectors, flags, filters, task names, source/dependency graphs, Mockito agent setup/providers, metadata profiles, and Testcontainers scheduling unchanged. Baseline-only ReceiveSpansDisabled must stay off reactorTest/recoveryTest, and the experimental variants must retain their intended suites.

Verify the check graph in baseline and testLatestDeps modes from a fresh configuration without first explicitly realizing every suite; both reactorTest/recoveryTest defaults and their experimental variants must be included. Separately verify explicit suite realization still preserves the same flags and agent inputs. Run the narrowest applicable spotlessApply directly before focused existing verification, and record exact results and any environment blockers in the completion evidence. Do not wait for hosted CI, clean, disable caches, run a whole-repository build, redesign shared conventions, or change the helper-suite consolidation explicitly excluded from this batch.

Limit this correction to the RabbitMQ lifecycle wiring and necessary focused validation. Publish the correction to this original PR's current head; a local-only commit is not delivery.

replies.body: Added `tasks.check { dependsOn(testing.suites) }` and pushed as `678ffc86`. Fresh baseline and `testLatestDeps` check dry runs include both custom suites and their experimental variants; explicit task inspection confirmed flags and Mockito agent inputs are unchanged. The focused suite DSL test and RabbitMQ Spotless check passed.
